hooks.name: format-on-save
hooks.description: Formats files the agent just wrote. Enable after Phase 0 installs prettier.

hooks.name: related-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Runs the tests related to a changed source file and feeds failures back to the agent. Enable after Phase 0.

hooks.name: typecheck-on-stop
hooks.description: Typechecks when the agent finishes a turn so type errors are reported before the next prompt. Enable after Phase 0.
